masthead: COLLEGE OF ARTS, SCIENCES, AND TECHNOLOGY
EXIT INTERVIEW QUESTIONNAIRE FOR ON-THE-JOB (OJT) STUDENTS
headings: C. Application of Knowledge and Skills

questions.1: How would you describe your overall experience during your OJT?
questions.2: What were the most valuable experiences you gained during your OJT?
questions.3: What specific knowledge or skills did you learn or improve during your OJT?
questions.4: Which tasks or activities did you find most meaningful? Why?
questions.5: Were the tasks assigned to you related to your course or field of specialization? Please explain.
questions.6: What challenges or difficulties did you encounter during your OJT?
questions.7: How did you deal with or overcome these challenges?
questions.8: How would you describe the working environment in your assigned company/agency?
questions.9: Were you given sufficient orientation before starting your OJT?
questions.10: Were the facilities, equipment, and resources adequate for your training?
questions.11: How would you describe your relationship with your immediate supervisor or training officer?
questions.12: Did your supervisor provide adequate guidance, feedback, and support? Please explain.
questions.13: Were you treated fairly and respectfully as an OJT student?
questions.14: Were you able to apply the knowledge and skills you learned in school during your OJT?
questions.15: What academic knowledge or skills were most useful during your training?
questions.16: What skills did you realize you still need to improve?
questions.17: Did your OJT help you become more confident in performing work-related tasks? Why or why not?
questions.18: Did the OJT help you better understand the expectations and responsibilities of your future profession?
questions.19: What professional values or attitudes did you develop during your OJT?
questions.20: Did your OJT improve your communication, teamwork, time management, or problem-solving skills? Please give examples.
questions.21: What did you learn about workplace discipline, professionalism, and responsibility?
questions.22: Did the OJT experience influence your career plans or professional goals? How?
questions.28: What was the best aspect of your OJT experience?
questions.29: What was the most difficult or least satisfactory aspect of your OJT experience?
questions.30: What changes or improvements would you recommend for future OJT students?
questions.31: What advice would you give to students who will undergo OJT in the future?
questions.32: Would you recommend your OJT company/agency to future students? Why or why not?
questions.33: Overall, how would you rate your OJT experience?
questions.35: What is the most important lesson you learned from your OJT experience?
questions.36: What skills or competencies do you plan to further develop after completing your OJT?
questions.37: Is there anything else you would like to share about your OJT experience that was not covered by the questions above?

questions.2: Were your assigned tasks relevant to your academic program?

questions.5: Which skill do you think improved the most during your training?

will help evaluate the effectiveness of the Internship program and identify areas for improvement.
